description: The EPANET-JS toolkit compiles OWA-EPANET to WebAssembly with JavaScript and TypeScript bindings for browser and Node applications. This resource is provided by epanet-js (repository owner). Its method is not tied to one place; geographic inputs and simulation resolution depend on the user configuration. Access is through the linked repository or provider page; the exact file formats are not fully established. Licence: MIT. The public page or repository can be accessed free of charge. Limitation: This programming toolkit is separate from the epanet-js browser application. Pre-1.0 versions may contain breaking changes. For simulation, it can support model preparation or execution. Related catalogue record: model-epanet. The relationship follows the named method or resource; it does not certify file compatibility.
